dedupe_keys.name: bis cpmi red book statistics on payments and financial market infrastructures

description: The Red Book statistics of the Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures, published every year by the Bank for International Settlements, describe payment systems in the 27 CPMI member jurisdictions. The retail payments part has two sections: general macroeconomic statistics that relate the size of the payment industry to economic activity, with banknotes and coins in circulation and narrow money; and statistics on institutions offering payment services, cards and terminals, use of cashless payment instruments, cash withdrawals and deposits, with qualitative information on card schemes. Country tables show each jurisdiction over time and comparative tables combine them; related Red Book sections cover financial market infrastructures and their critical service providers. Data are free on the BIS data portal with bulk downloads and an API, under the BIS terms of permitted use, which allow unrestricted use provided the BIS is cited, translations are marked unofficial, use does not imply endorsement and commercial products add no charge for the data. Caveats: coverage is limited to CPMI members, definitions follow national reporting, and data are annual. For simulation it gives the size and use of national payment systems, a baseline for financial infrastructure disruption and cash-dependency scenarios. Related catalogue records include the Federal Reserve Payments Study and Fedwire statistics.
